subject: Social Studies
stem: The young revolutionary who, along with Rajguru and Sukhdev, was hanged in 1931 for his role in revolutionary activities against British rule, including throwing a (non-lethal) bomb in the Central Legislative Assembly to protest repressive laws, was:
explanation: Bhagat Singh, along with Rajguru and Sukhdev, was executed in 1931 following the Central Legislative Assembly bombing incident (1929) — distinct from Chandrasekhar Azad or Subhas Chandra Bose (who led the INA).
